releases.notes:
# 🚀 Kooda v0.4.1 — Modules, HUD & Improvements

## 🧩 New Modules

🧠 **Confuse**
A movement-based combat module that constantly repositions you around nearby enemies to disrupt their aim and tracking.

* Multiple modes supported:

  * **RandomTP** – Randomly teleports around the target within a configurable radius
  * **Switch** – Rapidly switches position relative to the enemy
  * **Circle** – Orbits the target at a fixed radius with adjustable rotation speed
* Smart **target selection** with priority options (health or distance)
* Optional **raycast checks** to prevent teleporting through walls *(with override option)*
* Built-in **visual rendering** around the target, including a performance-friendly mode

🔐 **AutoLogin**
Automatically enters saved passwords with a built-in secure saving system.

🛡 **KoodaAutoTotem**
An advanced AutoTotem system built to prevent deaths in extreme PvP situations, even on high ping and strict anticheats.

* Smart **danger detection** using real damage calculations (armor, enchants, absorption)
* Automatically equips totems when exposed to:

  * **End Crystals**
  * **TNT / Minecart explosions**
  * **Respawn Anchors (Nether)**
  * **Fall damage**
  * **Void falls**
  * **Low HP while using Elytra**
* Multiple **anti-fail & bypass systems**:

  * Packet spam & confirm packets for strict servers
  * Double-click logic (Matrix fix)
  * Inventory desync handling
  * Ping-based early equip prediction
* Flexible **inventory logic**:

  * Hotbar-first priority
  * Main-hand fallback if offhand fails
  * Optional swap-back after danger passes
  * Automatic hotbar refill
* Fully configurable **timing & delay controls**
* Optional **chat feedback** and screen flash alerts

Designed for high-risk combat where a single tick decides if you live or pop.

⛏ **AutoObsidian**
Automatically mines Ender Chests so you don’t get stuck mid-construction.
*(Baritone stop support coming soon)*

🤖 **AntiBot**
Automatically detects and removes fake / non-real players.

💥 **AntiCrash**
Prevents known crash exploits and malicious packets.

💬 **ChatBot**
Responds to chat commands like `!ping`, `!tps`, `!pos`.
More commands are planned.

🕷 **KoodaCrawlTrap**
A combat utility that automatically traps **crawling players** by placing blocks directly above their head, locking them in place.

* Detects players in **crawl state** within a configurable range
* Prioritizes the **closest targets**
* Automatically places blocks above the target using:

  * **Obsidian**
  * **Ender Chests**
  * **Respawn Anchors**
  * **Netherite Blocks**
* Supports **Silent** and **Normal** item switching
* Optional **packet-based placement** for faster, animation-less traps
* Sends **rotation packets** for improved GrimAC compatibility
* Configurable **blocks-per-tick** and placement delay
* Optional **3D render** showing trap placement positions

Extremely effective in **CrystalPvP** and tight combat scenarios where crawl abuse is common.

🪂 **KoodaNoPop**
Basic NoFall module, mainly intended to work alongside **MaceDMG** and other combat modules.

⚒ **MaceDMG**
Inspired by Vicore logic, TrouserStreak base, with additional functions from Wurst.

🎮 **KoodaRPC**
Discord Rich Presence integration.

🦘 **NoJumpDelay**
Removes the vanilla jump delay entirely.

🔊 **SoundLocator**
Detects and marks nearby sounds for improved awareness.

---

## 🖥 New HUD

📊 **CrystalMetrics**
Measures your crystal placement and detonation rhythm in real time.

---

## ⚙️ Improvements

🛠 **AntiRegearKooda** received major upgrades:

* Now fully compatible with **mining packets**
* Added a new **swap mode enum**: **Silent Swap** or **Normal Swap** *(with automatic swap-back)*
* Introduced a new **Damage slider**, adjustable from **0.7 to 1.0** for fine control

---

⚠️ This update focuses on PvP consistency, automation stability, and better combat feedback.
More updates and refinements are planned for upcoming versions.

releases.notes:
.

🚀 Highlights

Brand-new combat and utility modules

Major internal rewrites for better reliability

Visual spoofing and quality-of-life HUD additions

Tested under real server conditions (NCP / Grim)

🧠 HUD

Client Spoofer HUD
Displays watermarks from other clients for visual spoofing.

BitcoinHUD
Shows the current Bitcoin price in real time.

RealTimeClock
Displays real-world time.
Currently supports USA Central Time and Madrid only.

WatermarkHUD

Added two different logo styles.

⚔️ Modules

AntiLevitation

Added new Cancel mode to fully negate the levitation effect.

KoodaHoleESP

Now supports 1x2 and 2x1 holes.

KoodaDoubleHand

Fully rewritten from scratch.

Added new Silent Swap mode.

PanicButton (NEW)

Instantly enable or disable all modules with a single click.

SurroundPlus (NEW)

Designed to work on NCP and Grim.

Tested on SuperCraft, performing extremely well with 90+ ms ping.

Still under active improvement — feedback is appreciated.

ProjectileInterceptor (NEW)

Detects incoming ender pearls (commonly used for PearlPhase).

Automatically places a block to prevent the teleport.

AutoBookBan (NEW)

Automatically converts writable books into BookBan books.

Each book reaches ~133 KB.

A full shulker can potentially crash an entire client (intended behavior).

⚠️ Known Issues

SurroundPlus may occasionally stop placing blocks.

Workaround: Toggle the module off and back on.

🔮 Coming Soon

KoodaAnchorAura

KoodaAutoTotem

These modules are planned for future updates.
This release was published to avoid keeping users waiting while development continues.

✨ New Features
AntiLevitation: A new utility module designed to neutralize the Levitation effect.

Modes:

Velocity: Applies simulated gravity so you fall naturally.

Cancel: Completely removes the effect client-side.

⚔️ Combat & Beta
DoubleHand (Beta): Inspired by BozeClient (shoutout!). This module automatically swaps to a Totem in your hotbar when your health drops below a certain threshold.

Note: This module is currently in Beta. Please report bugs or suggestions on the official Kooda Discord.

🎨 Visuals & Polish
KoodaNotifierHud: Completely rewritten code with visual fixes and style improvements for a cleaner aesthetic.

KeyBindHud: Optimized internally with minor adjustments for better performance.

💻 Source Code / Experimental
GrimVelocity: An experimental module included in the source code, intended to bypass GrimAC. It is not enabled in the public build, but if you compile the addon yourself, you can register it or modify the logic to test it.

🚀 Kooda Addon Update
🆕 New Module: KoodaSelfTrap
I am excited to introduce the first in a series of PvP-focused modules for anarchy servers. KoodaSelfTrap is designed with a focus on compatibility and bypassing modern anti-cheats like GRIM and NCP.

[!IMPORTANT] This module is currently in Beta. Features may be refined, overhauled, or removed based on performance and feedback.

Bug Reports: If you encounter any issues, please open an issue or submit a report.

Goal: Providing reliable utility for competitive anarchy environments.

🔔 KoodaNotifier: Major Overhaul
We have significantly upgraded the notification system, adding more customization and fixing critical stability issues.

🛠️ Stability & Fixes
Crash Fix: Resolved a rare crash that occurred when joining a world.

Performance: Minor internal optimizations for better FPS stability.

⚙️ New Settings & Customization
Advanced Armor Alerts: You can now set a specific durability threshold (e.g., alert when armor is below N%) to trigger notifications.

Chroma Mode: Added dynamic RGB/Chroma support for notification visuals.

New Sound System: Implemented a brand-new audio system for alerts.

Enhanced UI: Completely overhauled notification styles for a cleaner and more modern look.

Expanded Options: Added various new toggles and settings for a fully personalized experience.

🤝 Community & Support
Stay updated, report bugs, or give feedback in our official community:

🎮 Join the Kooda Discord: https://discord.gg/NFFVMBkF

**KoodaAddon v0.2.0** is the first public release, built strictly for **Minecraft 1.21.10**. This update focuses on extreme stability, code cleanliness, and Anarchy-ready features.

> *We prioritize robust code execution over feature bloat. No spaghetti code, no memory leaks.*

### 🟢 NEW FEATURES

* **KoodaHoleSnap (Movement)**
    * **Dual Mode:** `Rage` (Instant pull) & `Legit` (Air-Strafe logic for Grim/NCP bypass).
    * **Anchor Logic:** Automatically brakes when directly over a hole to ensure a perfect drop.
    * **Safety:** Auto-disables when using Elytra or Climbing.

* **AutoToxic (Combat)**
    * **New Engine:** Built from scratch to replace legacy code.
    * **Smart Detection:** Only claims kills where you actually dealt damage (using `AttackEntityEvent`).
    * **True Pop Counter:** Thread-safe tracking with zero memory leaks.

* **WelcomerHud (Render)**
    * **Native Chroma:** Smooth, per-frame RGB rainbow effect.
    * **Crash-Proof:** Robust placeholders for Singleplayer/Multiplayer.

### 🟡 IMPROVEMENTS

* **KoodaNotifierHud:** Remastered with **8 Visual Styles** and `.wav` sound caching.
* **ToxicAura:** Added **Target Memory** (anti-spam) and invisible suffix bypass.

### ⚙️ TECHNICAL & REQUIREMENTS

* **Minecraft Version:** Java Edition **1.21.10** (Strict)
* **Fabric Loader:** Latest version for 1.21.10.
* **Meteor Client:** Dev Build compatible with 1.21.10.
* **Codebase:** Full refactor to Java 21 standards.

---
### 📥 INSTALLATION

1.  Download **Fabric Loader** for 1.21.10.
2.  Install **Meteor Client** (ensure it supports 1.21.10).
3.  Download `KoodaAddon-0.2.0.jar` from the assets below.
4.  Place the file in your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
